name: Acquia CMS DAM
description: Provides Acquia DAM integration/configuration for Acquia CMS.
project_description:
The purpose of this module is to integrate Acquia Drupal Starter Kit with Acquia DAM .

 It enables the following features:

 
 Adding DAM display settings for media of type image for different image styles. 
 Adding cohesion content templates for Acquia DAM media assets. 
 Provides the flexibility to alter the assets library from media library to library provided by acquia_dam. 
 
 INSTALLATION 
composer require drupal/acquia_cms_dam
 DOCUMENTATION 
Integrating Acquia DAM with Acquia Drupal Starter Kit
